articles.summary: Voice input for any app. Your users speak, and the Dictation API returns text that’s ready to send: filler gone, self-corrections resolved, names spelled right. Fast, accurate, and 32 languages.
articles.title: Introducing the Dictation API: the first API built for dictation

articles.summary: Universal-3.5 Pro is live on OpenRouter, served by the AssemblyAI Sync API. One POST to /audio/transcriptions returns a finished transcript, with prompting, conversation context, and keyterms passed through. No markup on our published rates.
articles.title: Universal-3.5 Pro is now on OpenRouter

articles.summary: A research comparison of Universal-3.6 Pro Realtime and Universal-3.5 Pro Realtime on English voice-agent conversations, turn detection, voice focus and multilingual recognition, with a comparison with other streaming systems.
articles.title: Universal-3.6 Pro Realtime: trained on real conversations, built for real voice agents

articles.summary: Universal-3.6 Pro Realtime is live. It gets the short utterances right. Plus, the same accuracy 3.5 Pro had on quiet calls, but now on loud rooms, accents and phone lines.
articles.title: Universal-3.6 Pro Realtime: your agent can take no for an answer | AssemblyAI
